Introductory programming contributes three option records, not three required courses. All other course categories remain legacy/unreviewed.

checks.degree_wide_requirements: Earlier complete inventory audit covers bachelor rules and UGER; that audit is not an independent correctness audit. Full general-education identity/description/category review remains unfinished.
